relics.description.scouring_eye.descript: An eye torn from the socket of one of the legendary End monsters. Despite the years passed, it is still alive and searching for a target for its next battle...
Remembers the last target attacked by the player for %2$s seconds. When the ability is activated, the player is teleported behind the remembered target and the ability goes on cooldown for %1$s seconds.
relics.description.scouring_eye.leveling: +%1$s XP for each teleportation to a target using the %2$s ability.
relics.description.void_vortex_in_bottle: A homework assignment of a student from the infamous magic school where students face deadly trials, capturing lightning, clouds, or vortexes in jars...

Upon killing a target, summons a void vortex %1$s blocks tall that pulls in nearby targets and goes on cooldown for %3$s seconds. After 5 seconds, the vortex explodes, dealing %2$s damage to all nearby targets. If a weaker or equal vortex is nearby, it absorbs it, growing in size and extending its duration.
+%1$s XP for each void vortex created by the %2$s ability.
relics.description.void_cloak.descriptio: A robe belonging to a mage who, according to legend, lived beneath the bedrock of any known world. There he mastered a never-before-seen magic of void runes and defeated a massive End beast, whose eye still roams in search of battle.
relics.description.void_cloak.ability.vo: Grants complete immunity to void damage.
Every %1$s seconds, summons a void rune under a random nearby target, dealing %2$s damage.
relics.description.void_cloak.ability.se: Upon the death of the player or their controlled creature, summons a seismic zone at the death location with a radius of %1$s blocks, triggering void runes up to %2$s times, each dealing %3$s damage.
relics.description.void_cloak.leveling_s: +%1$s XP for each activation of the %2$s ability.
+%1$s XP for each activation of the %2$s ability.
relics.description.vacuum_glove.descript: One of the filthiest tools, not wielded by warriors or mages, but by 'butchers'. Its aura liquefies the air around it, hindering both movement and mind.
Creates an area around the player with a radius of %2$s blocks that slows all targets trying to escape it by %1$s%% at the edge. The slowdown increases the closer a target is to the boundary.
relics.description.vacuum_glove.leveling: +%1$s XP for every 10 seconds of slowdown from the %2$s ability.
relics.description.void_bubble.descripti: A fragile yet durable device that protects the head, body, and mind all at once.
relics.description.void_bubble.ability.p: Encases the player's head in a protective bubble, completely eliminating the need for air. The bubble also blocks up to %1$s incoming attacks before exploding, scattering %2$s shards in all directions, each dealing %3$s damage. It then regenerates after %4$s seconds.
relics.description.void_bubble.leveling_: +%1$s XP for each attack blocked by the %2$s ability.
